scenes: Vanilla ice cream scoops in a wafer cone.
A newborn baby sleeping safely on its back in a cot, no loose blankets near face.
Blue morning glory trumpet flowers on a twining vine, heart-shaped leaves.
A trail of alternating bare human footprints pressed into damp sand.
A hydrangea shrub with rounded blue purple and pink flower clusters.
Small glossy dark red adzuki beans in a bowl and a few scattered beside it.
A small bright green Japanese tree frog on a leaf, toe pads visible.
A yellow raincoat, umbrella and rain boots displayed together.
A large dark rain cloud with raindrops falling onto a distant field.
A handheld catching net with a wooden handle and mesh hoop.
Rain falling across a garden with puddles and splash ripples.
Round brightly colored hard candies, some in clear twisted wrappers.
A slender dark water strider with six legs, long middle and rear legs resting on pond surface dimples.
Two children's hands playing cat's cradle with a red string stretched between fingers into a diamond lattice.
An accurate slender silvery ayu sweetfish with olive back and a golden cheek patch swimming in a clear river.
A raccoon with black eye mask and a ringed bushy tail.
A modest house with windows, front door and small garden.
An anatomically accurate squid swimming underwater, elongated mantle, two fins, eight short arms and TWO extra long feeding tentacles distinguishable.
A wooden raft made from logs tied together floating on water.
A friendly dog sitting, realistic animal proportions.
Ripe red strawberries with leafy green caps.
Whole and cut sweet potatoes with soil clinging to skins.
A large natural boulder with a child-sized tree for scale.
A dairy cow standing in a pasture, natural udder.
A horse standing in a field.
A wide blue ocean reaching the horizon with gentle waves.
A plum tree branch blooming early spring with five-petal round pink flowers.
A whole fuzzy peach and a cut half showing single pit.
A simple metal door key with bow and teeth.
Orange persimmon fruits with green leafy calyx.
A realistic brown pond frog beside water, long bent hind legs.
A realistic red crab with two claws and eight walking legs.
Several blank white paper sheets, one corner curled.
An empty clear drinking tumbler.
A realistic fish with gill cover and distinct fins swimming.
Cherry tree branch with pale pink blossoms and characteristic notched petals.
A Japanese macaque monkey with gray-brown fur and reddish bare face.
Fine white salt crystals in a small bowl, wooden spoon nearby.
A stag with branched antlers standing in woodland.
Whole striped watermelon with red sliced wedge and black seeds.
A bar of soap on dish with a few bubbles.
An expansive clear blue daytime sky with fluffy white clouds.
A realistic octopus underwater showing exactly eight arms with suckers, no extra arms.
A whole chicken egg and a cracked egg with shell, white and yellow yolk.
A natural butterfly perched on flower, two pairs of wings (four wings total), six legs.
A simple wooden study desk with notebook and pencil on top.
Ripe red tomatoes with green star shaped calyx.
Shiny purple eggplants with green caps.
A friendly domestic tabby cat sitting.
Thin dark green rectangular sheets of dried edible nori seaweed stacked on plate.
A brown wild boar with snout and short visible tusks.
A bottlenose dolphin swimming in blue sea, blowhole and horizontal tail flukes.
A white rabbit with long upright ears.
A small brown Eurasian tree sparrow with chestnut head and black cheek spot perched.
A whole yellow onion and cut half with concentric layers.
Earth's moon as a detailed pale cratered sphere against dark sky, no face.
A red crowned crane with long neck, long legs, white body and black flight feathers.
Orange carrots with fresh green tops.
A small natural gray mouse with round ears, pointed muzzle and long thin tail.
A ripe red apple and cut half showing seed core.
A bunch of yellow bananas with one partly peeled.
A giant panda with natural black white fur eating bamboo.
A tall sunflower with yellow petals and dark central disc.
A natural penguin standing on rocky Antarctic shore, flippers and webbed feet.
